name: Cell and Molecular Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual dates available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Directed research and rotations-if-required appear in curriculum; no single admission model assigned.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall priority
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; late space-available consideration to university final deadline.

applicationFee.note: Central graduate page permits financial-hardship waiver requests; international eligibility must be confirmed. Some departmental pages restrict waivers to named affiliated programs; department cannot waive directly.

english.note: Central scores valid within 2 years of entry; PTE 53, TOEFL Essentials 8.5 and other alternatives listed. Country-language and qualifying US degree/coursework exemptions may apply; confirm with program. No blanket English-medium exemption inferred. Department strongly recommends GRE for international applicants. Immediate TA oral legacy TOEFL 26 / TOEIC 160; assessment-course pathway has separate thresholds.

documents: Independent foreign transcript evaluation and translations
requirements.note: GPA 3. Statement should name 2–3 department faculty. Electronic references, not sealed hard copies to department. Spring priority July 1 international / August 1 US. Department legacy English 79 / IELTS 6.5 / DET 110; central new scale 4.5.

funding.note: TA stipend plus CAS class tuition waiver; RA stipend/tuition from mentor grants. Awards depend on budget/performance; summer TA not guaranteed.
